game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
observations: Nintendo describes characters living their final days independently along separate but intertwining paths.
Repeating the final days lets the player gather information, learn routines, arrive at specific times, and help different citizens.
Masks change abilities and which characters can be engaged.
inferences: Residents become parts of a temporal narrative system when their testimony and behavior are bound to scheduled state.
Repetition reveals perspectives without requiring every character to know the complete event.
limits: Official summaries do not document every schedule dependency or journal behavior.
This analysis does not treat every resident statement as fact.
